questions.prompt: X is a NumPy array with 2 rows (samples) and 3 columns (features): X = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]. What is the mean of the first feature (column 0), i.e. X[:, 0].mean()?
questions.explanation: Column 0 holds the values 1 and 4. Mean = (1 + 4) / 2 = 2.5.

questions.prompt: X is a NumPy array of shape (2, 3). X.mean(axis=1) averages over axis 1 (the columns) for each row. How many entries does the returned array have?
questions.explanation: Averaging over axis 1 removes that axis, so the shape (2, 3) becomes (2,): one mean per row. It has 2 entries.

questions.prompt: A has shape (2, 3) and B has shape (3, 4). The matrix product A @ B is valid. How many columns does A @ B have?
questions.explanation: For (m, k) @ (k, n) the result has shape (m, n). Here k = 3 matches, so the result is (2, 4) and has 4 columns.
